title: Decision Intelligence
desc: What changed between scenarios, which plans remain feasible, what is sensitive — and what evidence is missing. Units stay visible; no composite scores, no probabilities.
pickFieldDesc: Select a field to compare scenarios, sensitivity results and robust plans.
listDesc: Evidence-linked document over stored executions, sensitivity analyses and robust runs. A changed scope creates a new document (append-only).
rotationDesc: Shared plans per robust run — a plan is robust only across the explicitly selected scenarios and evaluated constraints.
robustRunLine: robust run {id} · {count, plural, one {# scenario} other {# scenarios}} · {seasons}
